Perfect! The logs clearly show the issue. The Prometheus pod's persistent volume ran out of disk space starting at 03:02:44. The error messages show "no space left on device" for the `/prometheus` directory. This happened right around the time gaps started appearing in the dashboards (03:00). When Prometheus can't write metrics to its storage, it can't collect data, which causes the gaps in Grafana dashboards and prevents alerts from firing.

Let me search for documentation on Prometheus storage to understand the recommended approach for handling full disks.

input.query: Prometheus storage capacity disk space management
